bounded_question: Define only V3 causal stochastic operation authority, named streams, seed lineage, candidate-set identity, event/draw coordinates, rule/version replay identity, persisted provenance, actor/genealogy isolation, and fail-closed behavior. Candidate semantics, scheduler precedence, V3 domain semantics, and V2 render randomness remain outside ADP-020.

root_seed_policy.recorded_os_csprng_rule: Exactly one named 32-byte OS-CSPRNG acquisition at creation of a new causal universe/run; exact resulting seed material and provenance MUST be persisted atomically before the first causal draw.

named_stream_model.registration_rule: Every semantic rule that may consume entropy MUST declare one exact static stream_name and an allowed ADP-020 operation in its governed rule-registry entry.

scope_contract.RUN: Only for explicitly governed pre-actor/run-level causal choices where the consumer proves no narrower stable scope exists.
scope_contract.ACTOR: Exact generated actor_id; actor identity must exist before actor-scoped draws.
scope_contract.JOINT: Exact owner-supplied content-addressed joint_scope_id; ADP-020 does not define participant/role semantics.
scope_contract.GENEALOGY: Exact owner-supplied content-addressed genealogy_scope_id; child actor streams subsequently derive from stable child_actor_id.

seed_lineage.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON; controlled keys sorted; no insignificant whitespace; Unicode strings NFC-normalized; integer numeric coordinate fields only.
seed_lineage.orthogonality_law: Rule identity and candidate-set identity participate in decision replay identity, not stream seed derivation, so semantic/candidate divergence is distinguishable from raw-entropy divergence.
seed_lineage.child_isolation: root -> ACTOR(child_actor_id) -> stream after lawful child identity creation

entropy_algorithm.uniform_below_contract: For 1<=n<=2^64-1, derive HMAC-SHA256(stream_seed, domain_separator || canonical(draw_coordinate) || canonical({block_index})); interpret first 8 bytes as unsigned big-endian x; limit=2^64-(2^64 mod n); reject x>=limit by incrementing internal block_index; return x mod n. Internal rejection blocks do not advance semantic draw_index.
entropy_algorithm.idempotence: Same draw coordinate plus same replay identity reuses/verifies the same receipt. Same coordinate plus different replay identity is RNG_DRAW_COORDINATE_REUSE_CONFLICT.

event_draw_index_semantics.anchor_event_index: Zero-based latest committed V3 causal ledger event anchoring the decision; -1 only for initialization.
event_draw_index_semantics.anchor_event_id: Exact anchor event ID, or INIT:<initial_checkpoint_hash>.
event_draw_index_semantics.rule_invocation_id: Stable identity supplied by the owning V3 rule/scheduler invocation contract; ADP-020 does not define scheduler precedence.
event_draw_index_semantics.decision_slot: Static rule-declared stochastic slot, never a filename or incidental loop position.
event_draw_index_semantics.occurrence_index: Zero-based owner-defined canonical semantic ordinal when the same slot lawfully recurs within one invocation; never filesystem/container order.
event_draw_index_semantics.draw_index: Zero-based entropy draw inside one decision; deterministic results have no draw index.
event_draw_index_semantics.result_event_index: Null until an outcome is independently admitted/generated as a V3 event; RNG never reserves or creates a causal event index.

allowed_stochastic_operations.authority_precondition: Nonempty already-lawful finite candidate set; owning semantic rule explicitly authorizes equiprobability.
allowed_stochastic_operations.draw_law: One UNIFORM_BELOW(candidate_count) draw unless candidate_count=1, then zero draws.

allowed_stochastic_operations.authority_precondition: Already-lawful finite candidates plus exact nonnegative integer weight_units supplied by owning semantic rule; at least one positive.
allowed_stochastic_operations.draw_law: One UNIFORM_BELOW(total_weight) draw unless exactly one positive-weight outcome, then zero draws.

allowed_stochastic_operations.authority_precondition: Exact integer numerator/denominator from owning semantic rule; 0<=numerator<=denominator and denominator>0.
allowed_stochastic_operations.draw_law: One UNIFORM_BELOW(denominator) only for 0<numerator<denominator; p=0/1 consumes zero draws.

allowed_stochastic_operations.authority_precondition: Owning semantic rule already authorizes inclusive finite integer [min,max].
Owning semantic rule supplies authorized integer-tick range and exact scale/quantization.
Owning semantic rule explicitly authorizes stochastic finite sampling.
allowed_stochastic_operations.draw_law: One semantic draw per nondeterministic selected position; deterministic remainder positions and k=0 consume none.

allowed_stochastic_operations.authority_precondition: Owning semantic rule explicitly makes order stochastic.
allowed_stochastic_operations.draw_law: Versioned Fisher-Yates using UNIFORM_BELOW; cardinality 0/1 consumes none.

identity_modes.SET_CANONICAL: Default. Candidate IDs NFC-normalized and unique. Canonical entries sorted by UTF-8 candidate_id then candidate_replay_hash only for content addressing/selection coordinate; this is not semantic precedence.
identity_modes.SEMANTIC_ORDERED: Only when owner declares order semantic. Persist contiguous semantic_position=0..n-1. Runtime iteration order cannot substitute.

candidate_set_contract.hash_formula: SHA-256('ADP020_CANDIDATE_SET_V1\0' || canonical_json({identity_mode,candidate_owner_authority,entries including candidate replay hashes and operation-relevant integer weights}))
candidate_set_contract.durability: Persist the full canonical candidate-set record or immutable content-addressed reference that exactly reconstructs it; hash alone is insufficient if the set cannot be recovered.
candidate_set_contract.empty_set_law: Zero RNG draws. Preserve semantic owner's lawful-empty/deferred/blocked state. No first-item/fabricated/random fallback.

deterministic_no_draw_law.recording: Persist DecisionReceipt with draw_consumed=false; no DrawReceipt and no dummy sequence advance.

decision_receipt_contract.replay_identity_formula: SHA-256('ADP020_DECISION_REPLAY_V1\0' || canonical_json(authority/algorithm versions + seed-lineage digests + draw coordinate + semantic rule identity + operation + stochastic_parameters_hash + candidate_set_hash/ref))

recording_obligations.retention: All replay-required RNG records are immutable/content-addressed for the lifetime of the replayable causal history.

deterministic_replay_contract.required_result: Recompute every stochastic decision and selected result, then reproduce the same admitted/generated V3 causal-event sequence and event/history/checkpoint hashes under the owning V3 rules.

divergence_classes.RULE_VERSION_DIVERGENCE: Rule/version changed while raw entropy coordinate may remain identical.
divergence_classes.CANDIDATE_SET_DIVERGENCE: Candidate-set identity changed while raw entropy coordinate may remain identical.
divergence_classes.RANDOM_DRAW_DIVERGENCE: Root/scope/stream/draw coordinate or recomputed entropy changed.

llm_boundary.law: A model may emit only a non-authoritative proposal under separate authority. Before ADP-020 may select among model proposals, each exact proposal must be content-addressed, recorded, independently admitted as a lawful candidate, and included in CandidateSetRecord.

cross_actor_genealogy_isolation.child_stream: root -> ACTOR(child_actor_id) -> named stream after lawful identity creation

failure_law: Authority/integrity/replay metadata failure blocks before causal mutation wherever possible. RNG failures are not semantic event outcomes and may not trigger random/default replacement behavior.

consumer_contract.V3-P2: Use root/scope/named-stream law for separately authorized stochastic actor/entity initialization; never invent missing initialization authority.
consumer_contract.V3-P4: Use stable rule-invocation/decision coordinates for stochastic opportunities; scheduler precedence remains outside ADP-020.
consumer_contract.V3-P5: Persist/link DecisionReceipt and DrawReceipt identities into event admission/DevelopmentalEventLedger/checkpoints; selection is not event admission.
consumer_contract.V3-P9: Apply actor/joint/genealogy/child isolation for separately authorized relationship/reproduction/child-generation stochastic choices.
consumer_contract.V3-P10: Select only among already-lawful attractor transition/interpretation candidates when their owning rule permits stochasticity; no topology/type fallback.
consumer_contract.V3-P11: Replay/completion court recomputes seed lineage, candidate-set hashes, decision/draw receipts, and event/history/checkpoint hashes.
